schedule.significant_improvement: V < significant_best_V - delta; equality is nonsignificant

schedule.on_decay: keep global significant_best; reset bad counter; change next update LR only; carry current LAST model/Adam/RNG, never splice BEST weights with LAST Adam
schedule.used_update_lr_vs_post_V_next_lr: separate actual fields; no repeated step or LR increase
schedule.floor_entry: first update actually using1e-6; observation that scheduled floor does not count floor training
schedule.floor_plateau: actual training draws at floor >=8*R AND8 consecutive full-V observations at floor without significant improvement
schedule.floor_boundary_rounding: actual draw inequality is authoritative; eight rounded intervals may require a ninth observation to reach8R
schedule.floor_best_tiny_minimum: may update strict BEST but cannot reset significant patience
schedule.old_stop4: not used; old static recipe/results unchanged

overfit_STOP.sustained: three consecutive ordinary full-V points, all with updates at floor; otherwise streak resets
overfit_STOP.nonfloor: record diagnostic divergence; normal three-stale LR decay continues, no premature old stop4
overfit_STOP.verdict: OVERFIT_STOP/NEEDED_WORK, preserve strict BEST; operational divergence, not population overfit proof
overfit_STOP.priority_at_same_point: nonfinite/error/cancel/resource > OVERFIT_STOP > floor plateau > finite draw/quota cap
